title: Use the geometric series condition
text: The series converges when $$|2x|<1$$, that is, when $$|x|<\frac{1}{2}$$.

title: Check the endpoints
text: At $$x=\frac{1}{2}$$ and $$x=\frac{-1}{2}$$ the terms are $$1$$ and $${\left(-1\right)}^n$$, which do not go to $$0$$, so the interval is $$(\frac{-1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$$.
